name: Margot Steijger
bio: PhD candidate at the University of Amsterdam’s Conscious Brain Lab, supervised by Simon van Gaal and supported by an ERC Consolidator Grant. With degrees in Psychobiology and Biomedical Sciences from the University of Amsterdam, their research background includes work at the University of Cambridge on decision-making and neural dynamics during drowsiness. Their PhD examines how arousal influences performance and conscious perception, using behavioural experiments, pupillometry, and neural and physiological measures.
